definitions.explanation: Maintaining the same attitude, policy, or approach from beginning to end without wavering. Emphasizes steadfastness and lack of contradiction.

examples.japanese: {一貫|いっかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{一貫|いっかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}している→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧。
examples.english: She has been consistently opposed from the beginning.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{一貫|いっかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This company handles everything in-house consistently, from planning to manufacturing.

notes:
{一貫|いっかん} literally means "one thread" and conveys the idea of an unbroken line running through something from start to finish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一貫|いっかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ (consistently, throughout)
- {一貫|いっかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (consistent stance)
- {一貫|いっかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧ (consistent policy)
- {一貫|いっかん}⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ (integrated production)
- {一貫|いっかん}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (integrated education, e.g., combined elementary-middle school)

USAGE:
- {一貫|いっかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ is the most common form, functioning as an adverb meaning "consistently" or "throughout"
- Often used in business and organizational contexts to describe processes done entirely in one place
- Not to be confused with ⟦{一環|いっかん}→一環：17696_ikkan⟧ (part of, a link in a chain), which has the same reading but different meaning
